methodology: Option A: Independent Single-Set SSR for Six Constructs (Comparison Mode (Canonical vs. Improved))
embedding_notes: Local Ollama nomic-embed-text (768 dims) used instead of paper's OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (1536 dims) for 100% offline, local execution.

construct_responses.PE: The smartphone has a powerful processor and good battery life, making it effective for daily tasks and app usage. It offers a smooth and reliable performance that should meet most users' needs.
construct_responses.EE: Setting up and navigating the smartphone is straightforward, thanks to a user-friendly interface. The controls are intuitive, making it easy to operate even for first-time users.
construct_responses.HM: Using this smartphone for daily tasks and media viewing is a pleasant experience. The display is clear and the performance is responsive, enhancing the overall satisfaction.
construct_responses.SI: My peers and colleagues who use smartphones would likely find this device reliable and performant, making it a good choice for personal use.
construct_responses.PP: The build quality feels robust, and the device seems durable. With its strong performance, I expect it to last for a considerable amount of time without any issues.
construct_responses.BI: I am certain I will continue using this smartphone as my primary phone, given its solid build quality and responsive performance at a pocket-friendly price. It meets my high standards for a reliable smartphone.
construct_responses.OVERALL: This smartphone offers a good balance of performance and build quality, making it a satisfying choice for daily use. It feels like a worthwhile investment at the given price.
